about: How the nightly runs write a lead's location, and the tier the page must give each one. `forms` names each form the prompt teaches; every case says which form it writes. `ranked` is a person's 'Which locations should come first?' list as typed; `tier` is the 0-based rank the written location must land in, or null for a location that must match nothing. The page's matcher test runs every case (locations.test.ts); server/verify-local.mjs reads this file by path and checks the prompt teaches every form in `forms`.

forms.us-city: City, ST - a US city with its two-letter state
forms.city-country: City, Country - a city outside the US with its country
forms.remote-country: Remote (<country>) - remote, open to one country

cases.why: a shared city name matches only with its own state
a place nobody ranked has no tier
remote in another country is not Remote US
remote in another country is not Remote Canada
one of several locations is enough
several locations take the best tier among them
